description: Namespace-level drill-down from OTel Kubernetes Cluster dashboard — workload replica status, pod/container resource usage, network, and filesystem metrics

links.title: Container Detail →
links.tooltip: Drill down to per-container CPU and memory detail

links.title: Network Detail →
links.tooltip: Drill down to network traffic by namespace and pod

links.title: Host Metrics →
links.tooltip: Drill down to per-node host metrics

panels.title: Pods Running
panels.description: Number of pods in Running phase (phase=2) in this namespace

panels.title: Pods Pending
panels.description: Number of pods in Pending phase (phase=1) in this namespace

panels.title: Pods Failed
panels.description: Number of pods in Failed phase (phase=4) in this namespace

panels.title: Container Restarts
panels.description: Total container restart count in this namespace

panels.title: Containers Not Ready
panels.description: Number of containers reporting not-ready state in this namespace

panels.title: Total CPU Usage
panels.description: Sum of CPU usage across all pods in this namespace (cores)

panels.title: Workload Availability
panels.description: Worst-case workload availability (deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets) within this namespace over the selected window. Use to establish SLA baselines and measure Spot vs On-Demand impact.

panels.title: Deployments
panels.description: Deployment replica status — desired vs available replicas. Missing column highlights deployments with unavailable replicas

panels.title: StatefulSets
panels.description: StatefulSet replica status — desired, ready, current, and updated pod counts

panels.title: DaemonSets
panels.description: DaemonSet scheduling status — desired, ready, and misscheduled node counts

panels.title: Pod CPU Usage
panels.description: CPU usage per pod in cores (from kubeletstatsreceiver)

panels.title: Pod Memory Working Set
panels.description: Memory working set per pod in bytes (from kubeletstatsreceiver)

panels.title: CPU: Usage vs Requests vs Limits
panels.description: Namespace-level aggregate CPU usage compared to sum of container CPU requests and limits — shows if namespace is over/under-provisioned

panels.title: Memory: Usage vs Requests vs Limits
panels.description: Namespace-level aggregate memory working set compared to sum of container memory requests and limits — shows if namespace is over/under-provisioned

panels.title: Container Resource Requests & Limits
panels.description: Per-container CPU and memory requests and limits for all pods in this namespace

panels.title: Container Restarts Over Time
panels.description: Container restart count over time — spikes indicate crash loops or OOM kills

panels.title: Container Memory Major Page Faults
panels.description: Rate of major page faults per container — spikes indicate memory pressure forcing disk reads (from kubeletstatsreceiver container.memory.major_page_faults metric, deriv over 5m)

panels.title: Pod Network I/O
panels.description: Pod-level network receive and transmit rates (from kubeletstatsreceiver)

panels.title: Pod Network Errors
panels.description: Pod-level network error rates (from kubeletstatsreceiver)

panels.title: Pod Filesystem Usage
panels.description: Filesystem usage as a percentage of capacity per pod

panels.title: Pod Filesystem Usage Over Time
panels.description: Filesystem usage in bytes per pod over time
